02 / GET A HEAD START

READY. SET. BUILD.

A little preparation goes a long way.
Here’s where you can begin.

01

Find the problem.

Start with something that matters. Think about who needs your solution and how AI or machine learning could help.

02

Make it work.

Explore your approach, build a prototype, and learn from what your experiments tell you.

03

Show the value.

Prepare a focused demonstration. Explain the problem, your choices, and what your solution can do.

These are preparation suggestions. Official rules, requirements, and judging criteria will be announced separately.

03 / BEFORE YOU ENTER

KNOW YOUR
ARENA.

The essentials, as they’re announced.

What is the prize pool?+

Neural Nexus has a ₹60,000 prize pool: ₹30,000 for first place, ₹20,000 for second, and ₹10,000 for third.

What is Neural Nexus?+

Neural Nexus is the AI/ML Hackathon at Elevate 3.0, bringing artificial intelligence and machine learning into the event’s village-inspired arena.

Who can participate?+

Eligibility, team size, and participation guidelines will be announced before registration opens.

What are the challenges and judging criteria?+

Challenge statements, judging criteria, submission requirements, and event duration are being finalized. Confirmed details will appear here.

When does registration open?+

The registration date and sign-up link will be announced here. No applications are being collected yet.
